sloka: सो ऽन्यत् कार्मुकमादय सज्यं चक्रे त्वरन्निव।तदप्यस्य त्रिभिर्बाणैर्लक्ष्मणो निरकृन्तत ।। ६.९१.१८ ।।
transliteration: so 'nyat kārmukamādaya sajyaṁ cakre tvaranniva।tadapyasya tribhirbāṇairlakṣmaṇo nirakṛntata ।। 6.91.18 ।।

translations.english: Indrajith seizing another bow hastily targeted at Lakshmana and Lakshmana split them with three arrows.
